start: Settings, a member not signed in, with some workouts on the phone

steps.action: Open Settings, Your data, tap 'Backup and restore'
user_sees: Title 'Backup and restore'
Card 'Keep your workouts on MettleUp' with 'Sign in with Google to keep your workouts safe...'
'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.'
Rows 'Download my data' and 'Restore from a backup'
must_not: A second backup choice (Google Drive backup) offered as a way to back up

steps.action: Tick the 18 or older and terms box above the button
user_sees: The box shown ticked
must_not: The box asked again on every visit after it was ticked once

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' and pick a Google account
user_sees: Google's account picker, then back on the card
must_not: Google sign-in opening before the box is ticked
Two sign-ins started by a second tap while busy

steps.action: Look at the card after sign-in
user_sees: 'Signed in as <email>'
'Your workouts are saved to your MettleUp account automatically. Last saved: <date>, <time>.' or 'Your workouts will be saved on MettleUp in a moment.'
Buttons 'Bring back my workouts', 'Sign out', 'Delete my account'
must_not: A 'Last saved' time for a copy that was never made
Progress photos sent to the account

start: Backup and restore page, a member with workouts and photos

steps.action: Tap 'Download my data'
user_sees: Title 'Download my data'
'One file with your workouts, routines in their order, your own exercises, ... photos, profile and settings.'
'Your phone number and your gym membership are never in the file.'
must_not: The page called a backup that replaces the account

steps.action: Tap 'Save the backup file'
user_sees: The button shows 'Saving 3 of 40 photos...' while it works
The share sheet titled 'Download my data'
must_not: The button tappable twice making two files

steps.action: Pick Files or Google Drive in the share sheet
user_sees: 'Saved <file name> (<size>): <n> workouts and <n> photos.'
must_not: A success line when sharing is not available on the phone
The phone number or gym membership inside the file

start: Backup and restore page, a member with a backup file saved earlier (also from the old ForgeAI app)

steps.action: Tap 'Restore from a backup', tap 'Choose backup file', pick the file
user_sees: Title 'Restore from a backup'
What is inside the file, before anything changes
Buttons 'Replace everything on this phone', 'Add to what's here', 'Choose another file'
must_not: Anything on the phone changed just by picking the file

steps.action: Tap 'Replace everything on this phone'
user_sees: Question 'Delete <n> workouts first?' with 'A copy is kept while you stay on this screen, so you can undo.'
must_not: Workouts deleted with no question when the phone has workouts

steps.action: Confirm
user_sees: 'Putting back your workouts and routines...'
'Restored <n> workouts, <n> routines, <n> measurements and <n> photos.'
Button 'Undo restore'
must_not: Half the workouts replaced when the restore fails
Health Connect shown as on without the member turning it on again

start: Restore from a backup, file picked, phone already has workouts

steps.action: Tap 'Add to what's here'
user_sees: 'Restored <n> workouts ... <n> workouts were already here, so they were left out.'
must_not: A workout already on the phone added a second time
The phone's settings replaced by the file's settings

start: Backup and restore page on a build where Google Drive is set up, a member with an old Drive backup

steps.action: Tap the small underlined link 'Bring back a Google Drive backup'
user_sees: Title 'Google Drive backup'
A way to bring an old Drive backup to this phone only
must_not: Any button that backs up to Drive again
The link shown on a build without Drive set up

start: New phone, a member signed in to the MettleUp account

steps.action: On the Backup and restore card tap 'Bring back my workouts'
user_sees: '<n> workouts brought back to this phone.' or 'Everything was already on this phone.'
must_not: Workouts brought back twice by a second tap
Another person's workouts brought to this phone

start: Cloud test only: the unlinked Android phone-backup page opened by its link

steps.action: Open the page by its link (no Settings row leads here)
user_sees: Title 'This phone's backup'
The workout count and 'Include photos in my backup'
must_not: A Settings row that leads a member to this page

steps.action: Tap 'Choose backup file' and pick a photo or any file that is not a MettleUp backup
user_sees: A red line saying why the file cannot be opened
Still the 'Choose backup file' button
must_not: Anything on the phone changed
A crash or an endless spinner

steps.action: Start a workout, come back, pick a real backup and tap 'Replace everything on this phone'
user_sees: 'Finish your workout first: finish or discard the workout in progress, then restore.'
must_not: The workout in progress replaced or lost

start: Download my data, the phone holds only the sample member's demo data, or nothing at all

steps.action: Tap 'Save the backup file' on demo data
user_sees: 'This is the sample member's made-up data, so there is nothing of yours to back up.'
must_not: A file of made-up data handed to the share sheet

steps.action: Erase the demo, tap 'Save the backup file' with no workouts and no routines
user_sees: 'Nothing to back up yet. Log a workout or make a routine first.'
must_not: An empty file shared
An error message

start: Backup and restore card, the box not ticked

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' without ticking the 18 or older and terms box
user_sees: A red line under the button asking to tick the box
must_not: Google sign-in opening
The account made without the terms agreed

start: Restore from a backup, a restore just finished

steps.action: Tap 'Undo restore'
user_sees: 'Putting this phone back...'
'Done. This phone is back to how it was before the restore.'
must_not: Workouts from the backup left behind after undo
Undo offered a second time after it ran

steps.action: Restore again, then leave the page and come back
user_sees: No 'Undo restore' button any more
must_not: An undo that brings back an old copy after leaving the screen without saying so

start: Backup and restore card, signed in

steps.action: Tap 'Delete my account'
user_sees: Question 'Delete your MettleUp account?' with 'This deletes your account and everything saved on MettleUp's server. The workouts on this phone stay.'
Red button 'Delete account'
must_not: The account deleted with no question

steps.action: Tap 'Delete account'
user_sees: 'Your account and everything saved on MettleUp are deleted. Your workouts are still on this phone.' (or the gym sign-in kept wording)
The card back to 'Continue with Google'
must_not: Workouts on the phone deleted
The cloud copy still there after the deleted message

steps.action: Sign in again, then tap 'Sign out' and confirm 'Sign out of MettleUp?'
user_sees: The card shows 'Continue with Google' again
must_not: Workouts removed from the phone on sign-out

start: Backup and restore, signed in, a member who trains at a gym

steps.action: Read the card and log a workout with a progress photo
user_sees: 'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.'
must_not: The gym panel showing the member's saved copy
Progress photos uploaded to the account copy

steps.action: Tap 'Download my data' and save the file
user_sees: The file holds workouts and photos but no phone number and no gym membership
must_not: The phone number or gym membership inside the file
